name: Front intake placer
basis: Invented teaching concept for the training field: one front intake and one front placer that sets a piece on a target at short range. Every number is a placeholder for the project to replace.

frameLengthIn.label: assumed
frameLengthIn.basis: Invented frame length for a block-bot rehearsal.

frameWidthIn.label: assumed
frameWidthIn.basis: Invented frame width for a block-bot rehearsal.

bumperIn.label: assumed
bumperIn.basis: Invented bumper depth: backing plus padding plus cover.

stowedHeightIn.label: assumed
stowedHeightIn.basis: Invented stowed height with the placer lowered.

maxHeightIn.label: required
maxHeightIn.basis: Invented teaching cap on the raised placer height.

maxReachIn.label: assumed
maxReachIn.basis: The placer's reach beyond the frame perimeter.

massLb.label: assumed
massLb.basis: Invented student estimate from a comparable earlier block-bot build.

topSpeedInS.label: assumed
topSpeedInS.basis: Default sweep bound 120–240 in/s: about 80% of COTS module free speed (https://www.swervedrivespecialties.com/products/mk4i-swerve-module, https://choreo.autos/document-settings/robot-configuration/). Replace with the project's module, gearing and current limits.

accelInS2.label: assumed
accelInS2.basis: Default sweep bound 150–400 in/s²: below the traction limit once current limits apply (https://choreo.autos/document-settings/robot-configuration/, https://pathplanner.dev/robot-config.html). Replace with the project's current limits and wheel friction.

rotationDegS.label: assumed
rotationDegS.basis: Default sweep bound 180–540 deg/s: shipped planner and library rotation caps (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjansen4857/pathplanner/e02bbf3176588166e8fe5192ab8dea85f6d62f7a/lib/util/prefs.dart, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wpilibsuite/allwpilib/v2026.2.1/wpilibjExamples/src/main/java/edu/wpi/first/wpilibj/examples/swervebot/Drivetrain.java). Replace with the project's tuned cap.

widthIn.label: assumed
widthIn.basis: Invented roller width, inside the bumpered front face.

extensionIn.label: assumed
extensionIn.basis: Invented deploy distance beyond the bumper.

headingToleranceDeg.label: assumed
headingToleranceDeg.basis: Invented misalignment the rollers still center.

tile.label: assumed
tile.basis: Invented placer that holds one piece.

transferS.label: assumed
transferS.basis: Invented time to hand a piece from the intake to the placer.

secondsPerPiece.label: assumed
secondsPerPiece.basis: Invented time to raise, release and clear.

successFraction.label: assumed
successFraction.basis: Invented share of placements that score.

standOffIn.label: assumed
standOffIn.basis: Invented distance band from the face to the target.

headingToleranceDeg.label: assumed
headingToleranceDeg.basis: Invented misalignment the placer still lands.
